definitions.ask: Which new punctuation should a drawer title accept?
definitions.why: Covers questions and the colon headers already in the vault, but not LABEL: value notes

choices.label: Adds ? ! ; anywhere plus a trailing : (OPTIONS:); LABEL: value notes stay plain notes
Adds only ? and !; colon-ended headers like OPTIONS: stay plain notes
Adds ? ! ; : anywhere except ::; ALL-CAPS LABEL: value notes also become drawers

definitions.ask: Should typing the slug #what-is-sase also select the punctuated drawer WHAT IS SASE?
definitions.why: One identity rule, like existing Q&A drawers; the - # menu works either way

choices.label: Punctuation stays part of drawer identity, like Q&A; #what-is-sase gets a fixable refusal
#what-is-sase selects WHAT IS SASE?; more resolver work and new ambiguous-slug cases
